descriptive_finding: Reconciliation is exact (gross - friction - net = 0.0). Gross expectancy is effectively zero (+0.0003R over 31 occurrences) -- the raw, pre-friction trade edge is indistinguishable from breakeven at this sample size. Friction consumes 50.5% of all gross POSITIVE R generated (11.647R gross-positive vs 5.886R total friction), and friction alone (5.886R) is almost exactly equal in magnitude to the entire net loss (-5.877R). This is evidence mechanism (B) -- friction overwhelming near-zero gross economics -- dominates over mechanism (A) -- negative gross trade economics are NOT evidenced; gross_expectancy_R is not meaningfully negative. Friction is fairly uniform across setups (S1 0.224R, S2 0.238R, S3 0.151R mean) and sessions (ASIAN_LONDON 0.208R, LONDON_NEWYORK 0.173R mean) -- no single setup/session concentrates friction disproportionately; it is a broad, structural drag rather than an isolated pocket.
source: Read-only aggregation over artifacts/research/EXP_EXPOSURE_EFFICIENCY_V1/GEN_001/per_trade_results.csv (policy==CONTROL rows only), justified by SSC1D-WP2's confirmed population_hash match to this exact 31-occurrence population. No baseline rerun. No strategy code executed.
